mapper.select: SELECT id AS student_id, last_response_at, COALESCE(last_response_at, completed_on) AS inactivity_since FROM student WHERE id = #{studentId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: SELECT ri.id AS item_id, ri.response, ri.pass_reason, ri.responded_at FROM recommendation_item ri JOIN recommendation r ON r.id = ri.recommendation_id WHERE r.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY ri.responded_at DESC, ri.id DESC
SELECT id FROM help_request WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM application WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'APPROVED', 'DELIVERED') ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM recommendation WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM recommendation_item WHERE recommendation_id = #{recommendationId} ORDER BY id
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM student ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_status (student_id, status, sub_status, reason) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{decision.status}, #{decision.subStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{decision.reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = #{decision.status}, sub_status = #{decision.subStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, reason = #{decision.reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
